#!/bin/bash

# Deployment Script
# Creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes: node_modules, .git

set -e  # Exit on error

# Color codes for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# ============================================================================
# Pre-deployment Validation - Check Environment Variables
# ============================================================================
validate_env_vars() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    local missing_vars=0
    local checked_vars=0

    echo ""
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "  Pre-deployment Validation"
    echo "=========================================="

    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo -e "${RED}✗ Error: $env_file not found${NC}"
        echo "  Please create $env_file with required environment variables."
        exit 1
    fi

    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Found $env_file${NC}"
    echo "  Checking environment variables..."
    echo ""

    # Read and validate each variable
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi

        # Extract variable name (before =)
        var_name="${line%%=*}"
        # Extract variable value (after =)
        var_value="${line#*=}"

        ((checked_vars++))

        # Check if value is empty
        if [ -z "$var_value" ] || [ "$var_value" = "${var_name}=" ]; then
            echo -e "  ${RED}✗ Missing value:${NC} $var_name"
            ((missing_vars++))
        else
            echo -e "  ${GREEN}✓${NC} $var_name"
        fi
    done < "$env_file"

    echo ""
    echo "  Checked $checked_vars variable(s)"

    # Exit if any missing variables
    if [ $missing_vars -gt 0 ]; then
        echo -e "  ${RED}✗ Validation failed: $missing_vars variable(s) missing values${NC}"
        echo "=========================================="
        echo ""
        exit 1
    else
        echo -e "  ${GREEN}✓ All environment variables are set${NC}"
        echo "=========================================="
        echo ""
    fi
}

# Run validation
validate_env_vars

# ============================================================================
# Create Release Archive
# ============================================================================

# Get the current directory name for the archive
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

echo "Excluding: node_modules, .git"

else

fi

  echo "✓ Pre-deployment validation passed"
  echo ""
}

# Convert .env file to JSON format
env_to_json() {
  local env_file="$1"
  local json="{"

  local first=true
  while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

    # Remove surrounding whitespace from key and value

    value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)

    # Escape special characters in JSON strings

    value=$(printf '%s' "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g')
    # Escape double quotes
    value=$(printf '%s' "$value" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')

    if [ "$first" = true ]; then
      first=false
    else
      json="${json},"
    fi

    json="${json}\"${key}\":\"${value}\""
  done < "$env_file"

  json="${json}}"
  printf '%s' "$json"
}

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script
# Creates a release archive of the current directory, excluding node_modules and .git

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Pre-deployment validation function
validate_env_vars() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    local missing_vars=()
    local empty_vars=()

    echo "Running pre-deployment validation..."
    echo "Checking environment variables from $env_file..."

    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "✗ Error: $env_file not found!"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo ""

    # Read and validate each variable from .env.test
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines, comments, and lines without '='
        if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# || "$key" != *"="* ]]; then
            continue
        fi

        # Extract the key (part before first '=')
        var_name="${key%%=*}"

        # Check if value is empty or only whitespace
        if [[ -z "${value// }" ]]; then
            empty_vars+=("$var_name")
        fi
    done < "$env_file"

    # Report validation results
    if [[ ${#empty_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "✗ Validation failed! The following environment variables have no value:"
        for var in "${empty_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        echo ""
        echo "Please set all required variables in $env_file before deploying."
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "✓ All environment variables are properly set"
    echo ""
}

# Run validation
validate_env_vars

# Get the directory name
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment Script
# Creates a release archive of the current directory

# Set variables
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}}")" && pwd)"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Get the directory name to use as the root folder in the archive
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$SCRIPT_DIR")

echo "=========================================="
echo "Deployment Script"
echo "=========================================="
echo "Creating release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo "Source directory: $SCRIPT_DIR"
echo ""

# Create the tar.gz archive
# Excludes:
#   - node_modules/ (dependency directories)
#   - .git/ (version control)
#   - Also common exclusions for cleaner releases
tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='.gitignore' \
    --exclude='.DS_Store' \
    --exclude='*.log' \
    --exclude='.env' \
    --exclude='.env.*' \
    -C "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." "$DIR_NAME"

# Check if archive was created successfully
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)
    echo "✓ Archive created successfully!"
    echo "  File: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
    echo "  Size: $ARCHIVE_SIZE"
    echo ""
    echo "To deploy, upload and extract the archive:"
    echo "  tar -xzf $ARCHIVE_NAME"
else
    echo "✗ Error: Failed to create archive"
    exit 1
fi

echo "=========================================="

    echo "=========================================="

  echo "Size: $FILE_SIZE"
  echo ""

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script - Creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes: node_modules, .git, and the archive itself

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Configuration
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz"
PROJECT_DIR="${1:-.}"  # Use current directory if no argument provided

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

echo -e "${YELLOW}Creating deployment archive...${NC}"

# Check if directory exists
if [ ! -d "$PROJECT_DIR" ]; then
    echo -e "${RED}Error: Directory '$PROJECT_DIR' does not exist${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

# Get the directory name for the archive root
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(realpath "$PROJECT_DIR")")

# Create the archive excluding specified directories/files
# --exclude patterns: node_modules, .git, and the archive itself
tar \
    --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='*.tar.gz' \
    -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    -C "$(dirname "$(realpath "$PROJECT_DIR")")" \
    "$DIR_NAME"

if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓ Success! Archive created: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}${NC}"
    
    # Display archive info
    ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)
    echo -e "  Size: $ARCHIVE_SIZE"
    
    # Optionally list contents
    if [ "${2:-}" == "--list" ] || [ "${2:-}" == "-l" ]; then
        echo -e "\n${YELLOW}Archive contents:${NC}"
        tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | head -20
        TOTAL_FILES=$(tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | wc -l)
        echo -e "... and $((TOTAL_FILES - 20)) more files"
        echo -e "Total files: $TOTAL_FILES"
    fi
    
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${RED}✗ Failed to create archive${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script - Creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes: node_modules, .git, and the archive itself

set -e  # Exit on error

    echo "Location: ${PARENT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Function to send config to deployment orchestrator
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    local orchestrator_url="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"

    echo "🔄 Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
    echo "   URL: $orchestrator_url"

    # Convert .env.test to JSON using jq
    local json_payload
    json_payload=$(jq -n \
        --arg timestamp "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")" \
        --arg project "$DIR_NAME" \
        --argjson config "$(jq -Rs 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0 and .[0:1] != "#")) | map(split("=") | {key: .[0], value: (.[1:] | join("="))}) | from_entries' "$env_file")" \
        '{
            timestamp: $timestamp,
            project: $project,
            config: $config
        }')

    # POST to orchestrator API
    local response
    response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$json_payload" \
        "$orchestrator_url")

    local http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
    local body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')

    if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ]; then
        echo "   ✅ Configuration registered successfully"
        echo "   Response: $body"
    else
        echo "   ⚠️  Warning: Orchestrator returned HTTP $http_code"
        echo "   Response: $body"
        echo "   Continuing with deployment..."
    fi
    echo ""
}

# Run pre-deployment validation
validate_env_vars

# Send config to orchestrator for audit compliance
send_config_to_orchestrator

echo "📦 Creating deployment archive..."
